housing.sentenceEn: "We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing ," said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast.
housing.translationZh: “我们的出租住房供应已处于危机水平，”大海岸地区劳动力住房联盟执行董事尼克·泰勒说道。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

housing.sentenceEn: Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there's an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.
housing.translationZh: 如今，随着房价创下历史新高，而房屋库存量处于历史低位，此类监管的紧迫性愈发凸显，尤其是那些担心开发商会涌入市场、大量收购住房，然后在短租市场中转手牟取暴利的人们。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

housing.sentenceEn: However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of a local association of realtors.
housing.translationZh: 然而，当地房地产经纪人协会首席执行官瑞安·卡斯尔指出，短期租赁也为游客提供了住宿。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

housing.sentenceEn: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
housing.translationZh: 在新罕布什尔州，租金空置率已降至1%以下，住房权益倡导者担心，不受监管的短期租赁将给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

housing.sentenceEn: Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, "employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live," Taylor said.
housing.translationZh: 新罕布什尔州南部城镇缺乏足够的经济适用房，"雇主难以吸引员工，而员工也难以找到住处，"泰勒说。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

housing.sentenceEn: Its housing supply is at a very low level.
housing.translationZh: 其住房供应处于极低水平。

happiness.sentenceEn: Too much happiness can be destructive.
happiness.translationZh: 过多的快乐也可能具有破坏性。
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

happiness.sentenceEn: The researchers wanted to know if the optimism and inclination for risk-taking that come with happiness would change the way companies invested.
happiness.translationZh: 研究人员想知道，伴随幸福感而来的乐观精神和冒险倾向是否会改变企业的投资方式。
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

happiness.sentenceEn: But is it really happiness that's linked to investment, or could something else about happier cities explain why firms there spend more on R&D?
happiness.translationZh: 但真的是幸福感与投资相关联吗？还是说，幸福城市的其他因素可以解释为什么那里的公司在研发上投入更多？
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

happiness.sentenceEn: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: " Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness ."
happiness.translationZh: 正如中国哲学家庄子所言：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

happiness.sentenceEn: The relationship was also stronger in places where happiness was spread more equally.
happiness.translationZh: 在幸福感分布更为均衡的地区，这种关联也更为紧密。
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

happiness.sentenceEn: That's because happiness is linked to the kind of longer-term thinking necessary for making investments for the future.
happiness.translationZh: 这是因为幸福感与为未来投资所必需的那种长远思维有关联。
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

humanity.sentenceEn: "Yet the combined consequences of suppression and climate change have eroded humanity's ability to suppress fires, particularly those that ignite under the most dangerous weather conditions."
humanity.translationZh: 然而，森林防火抑制与气候变化的双重影响，削弱了人类扑灭山火的能力，尤其是那些在极端恶劣天气条件下诱发的火灾。
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

humanity.sentenceEn: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity 's greatest challenges.
humanity.translationZh: 然而，若要解决人类面临的最大挑战，证明科学的有效性将至关重要。
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

humanity.sentenceEn: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
humanity.translationZh: 换而言之：我们如何确保智能机器的思维能够反映人类的最高价值观？
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

humanity.sentenceEn: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
humanity.translationZh: 围绕三十米望远镜（TMT）的建造，抗议活动已经爆发。这是一个巨型天文台，有望彻底改变人类对宇宙的认知。
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

humanity.sentenceEn: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity .
humanity.translationZh: 《世界新闻报》的编辑宗旨并非增进读者理解、确保报道公正或是彰显共同的人性。
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

humanity.sentenceEn: Common humanity is central to news reporting.
humanity.translationZh: 共同的人性是新闻报道的核心。

highly.sentenceEn: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly .
highly.translationZh: 但事实是，你的老板可能对你的评价非常高。
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

highly.sentenceEn: But, with this newfound connection, many of us share sensitive, sometimes highly confidential information, even though over a third of people don't realise that AI platforms may not be very good at keeping our secrets…secret.
highly.translationZh: 但是，随着这种连接的日益紧密，我们中的许多人开始分享敏感甚至高度机密的信息，尽管超过三分之一的人并未意识到，AI 平台在保护个人秘密方面可能并不可靠。
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

highly.sentenceEn: "We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there's a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex," he said.
highly.translationZh: 他说：“我们的系统很复杂，没有多余的缓冲空间。只要线路上出现一点小问题，情况就会变得异常棘手。”
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

highly.sentenceEn: The findings showed that help-seekers generally underestimate how willing other people will be to help and how good it'll make the help-giver feel (for most people, having the chance to help someone is highly rewarding ).
highly.translationZh: 研究结果显示，求助者通常会低估他人提供帮助的意愿，以及这会给帮助者带来的愉悦感（对大多数人来说，有机会帮助他人是一件非常有意义的事情）。
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

highly.sentenceEn: "Distinguishing yourself in one focused type of extracurricular activity can be a positive in the admissions process, especially for highly selective institutions, where having top grades and test scores is not enough," Katie Kelley, admissions counselor at IvyWise admissions consultancy, wrote in an email.
highly.translationZh: IvyWise招生咨询公司的招生顾问凯蒂·凯利在电子邮件中写道："在某一特定类型的课外活动中脱颖而出，对大学申请过程可能会产生积极影响，尤其是在竞争激烈的顶尖院校——在这些学校，优异的成绩和考试分数是远远不够的。"
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

highly.sentenceEn: Highly paid managers lose their jobs.

historical.sentenceEn: In the study, the researchers compared the historical fire cadence with the wildfires recorded over the past few decades, and uncovered a striking shortfall.
historical.translationZh: 研究人员在研究中将历史火灾频率与过去几十年记录的野火进行了对比，发现两者之间存在显著差距。
historical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

historical.sentenceEn: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
historical.translationZh: 在创作之时，人们并未刻意进行保存，但这些模拟材料却有可能幸存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
historical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

historical.sentenceEn: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
historical.translationZh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
historical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

historical.sentenceEn: The result is an embarrassment of historical riches, which brings its own needle-and-haystack problems.
historical.translationZh: 结果是历史资料丰富得令人眼花缭乱，这也带来了大海捞针般的难题。
historical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

historical.sentenceEn: The Wickquasgeck Trail is an example of a historical desire path, created by Native Americans to cross the forests of Manhattan and move between settlements quickly.
historical.translationZh: 威克夸斯盖克小径是历史上"欲望路径"的一个例证，由美洲原住民开辟，用于穿越曼哈顿森林并在各定居点之间快速往返。
historical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

historical.sentenceEn: Keeping digital historical records is a challenge.
historical.translationZh: 保存数字化历史记录是一项挑战。

harm.sentenceEn: As summarized in a recent post on "The Hidden Dangers of Online Beauty Filters", relying on this technology for social presentation can cause harm such as body image issues, lower self-esteem, and social anxiety.
harm.translationZh: 正如最近一篇题为《在线美颜滤镜的隐藏风险》的博文所总结的那样，在社交展示中依赖这种技术可能会造成损害，例如身体意象问题、自卑以及社交焦虑。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

harm.sentenceEn: Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm .
harm.translationZh: 《联邦贸易委员会法案》第5条授权联邦贸易委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为采取执法行动，这意味着只有当某公司的隐私做法具有误导性或对消费者造成不正当损害时，联邦贸易委员会才能在事后采取行动。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

harm.sentenceEn: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures.
harm.translationZh: 高收入经理自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中不当解雇程序带来的损害。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

harm.sentenceEn: They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students' attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering.
harm.translationZh: 该研究的合著者、加州大学河滨分校哲学家埃里克·施维茨格贝尔表示，他们选择这一特定行为有三个原因：学生对这一话题的态度多变且不稳定；行为易于测量；伦理学文献普遍认为少吃肉有益，因为这能减少环境危害和动物痛苦。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

harm.sentenceEn: Thinking too much can also harm our ability to form preferences.
harm.translationZh: 思虑过多还会损害我们形成偏好的能力。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

harm.sentenceEn: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm ," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
harm.translationZh: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会“设计或部署”可能造成“全面伤害”的人工智能，也不会开发人工智能驱动的武器，或利用人工智能进行违反国际准则的监视活动。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

historian.sentenceEn: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians , and I'd be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.
historian.translationZh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏文献和数字资产展开的图书馆员，我与历史学家们有着同样的梦魇。如果说目前存在一个全面的保存解决方案，那我一定是在撒谎。
historian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

historian.sentenceEn: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians , and novelists rely on.
historian.translationZh: 在创作之时，人们并未刻意进行保存，但这些模拟材料却有可能幸存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
historian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

historian.sentenceEn: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
historian.translationZh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
historian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

historian.sentenceEn: "The visualization, particularly those photographs, really hit home that this is something that has to be protected," says Alicia Murphy, Yellowstone's park historian .
historian.translationZh: 黄石国家公园历史学家艾丽西亚·墨菲表示：“这些可视化作品，尤其是那些照片，真正让人们深刻认识到这是一个必须加以保护的地方。”

historian.sentenceEn: As a historian who's always searching for the text or the image that makes us re-evaluate the past, I've become preoccupied with looking for photographs that show our Victorian ancestors smiling (what better way to shatter the image of 19th-century prudery?).
historian.translationZh: 作为一名历史学家，我一直在寻找能让我们重新评价过去的文字或图像，如今我痴迷于搜寻那些展现维多利亚时代先祖们微笑的照片（还有什么比这更能打破19世纪拘谨刻板的形象呢？）。
historian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

historian.sentenceEn: They are in popular use among historians .
historian.translationZh: 它们在历史学家中被广泛使用。

handle.sentenceEn: A woman says there have been fewer street fights since the arrival of the wireless but also less stopping and "talking on the brush handle ".
handle.translationZh: 一位女性表示，自无线电广播出现以来，街头斗殴变少了，但停下来“倚着扫帚把聊天”的情况也随之减少了。
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

handle.sentenceEn: Today we fret about the isolating culture of smartphone-staring and selfie-vanity, but already in 1939 there was that lady regretting how, when all her street got wirelesses, it lost the neighbourly habit of "talking on the brush handle ".
handle.translationZh: 如今，我们对盯着手机看和沉迷自拍带来的孤立文化感到焦虑；但早在1939年，就有位女士感到遗憾，感叹自从整条街都装上无线电收音机后，大家就丢掉了那种邻里间“隔着篱笆聊天”的亲密习惯。
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

handle.sentenceEn: When the skills mismatch is in the broader economy though, the focus usually turns to government to handle .
handle.translationZh: 然而，当技能不匹配问题存在于更广泛的经济层面时，人们通常会期望政府来解决。
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

handle.sentenceEn: This also involves the agreements between European countries for the creation of a European bank for Television Production which, on the model of the European Investments Bank, will handle the finances necessary for production costs.
handle.translationZh: 这也涉及到欧洲各国达成协议，建立一个欧洲电视制作银行。该银行将以欧洲投资银行为蓝本，负责处理制作成本所需的资金。
handle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

handle.sentenceEn: "While we know how to tell a robot to handle a specific error," says Dave Lavery, manager of a robotics program at NASA, "we can't yet give a robot enough 'common sense' to reliably interact with a dynamic world."
handle.translationZh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）某机器人项目主管戴夫·拉维里表示：“我们虽然知道如何让机器人处理特定错误，但还无法赋予它们足够的‘常识’，使其能够可靠地与动态世界互动。”
handle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

handle.sentenceEn: By splitting up the subject matter into smaller units, one man could continue to handle the information and use it as the basis for further research.
handle.translationZh: 通过将研究课题分解为更小的单元，研究者可以继续处理这些信息，并将其作为进一步研究的基础。
handle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

highlight.sentenceEn: Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now.
highlight.translationZh: 威廉姆斯指出，生产成本的上升和参与者捐款的减少是“银屋街头派对”难以为继的主要原因，这凸显了当前所有街头艺术节组织者共同面临的现实。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

highlight.sentenceEn: Mumbai's April heatstroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings, researchers say.
highlight.translationZh: 研究人员表示，孟买4月的中暑死亡事件凸显了对更细致、更本地化预警的需求。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

highlight.sentenceEn: This clash highlights an ongoing struggle between the organic, user-driven evolution of public spaces and the desire for a visually curated and controlled urban environment.
highlight.translationZh: 这场冲突凸显了公共空间自发的、用户驱动的演变与打造视觉上精心策划和受控制的城市环境的愿望之间持续存在的矛盾。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

highlight.sentenceEn: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
highlight.translationZh: 动物的自然路径，例如鸭子在结冰的池塘中开辟出的水道，或是狗在花园里踏出的捷径，凸显了这类路径在人类与动物体验中所展现的适应性。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

highlight.sentenceEn: Those realistic possibilities are highlighted in the study presented by David Graddol.
highlight.translationZh: 大卫·格拉多尔（David Graddol）的研究报告凸显了这些现实可能性。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

highlight.sentenceEn: In 1337, Petrarch began work on his rambling writing De Viris Illustribus – On Famous Men, highlighting the virtus (or virtue) of classical heroes.
highlight.translationZh: 1337年，彼特拉克开始撰写他的鸿篇巨制《名人传》（De Viris Illustribus），着重颂扬古典英雄的"virtus"（即美德）。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

habitat.sentenceEn: Britain has relatively few butterfly species compared with mainland Europe and 80% are in decline, mostly because intensive chemical farming has reduced many species to tiny fragments of habitat and small nature reserves.
habitat.translationZh: 与欧洲大陆相比，英国的蝴蝶物种相对较少，其中80%的物种数量正在下降，这主要是因为集约化的化学农业将许多物种的栖息地缩减为零星的小块区域和小型自然保护区。

habitat.sentenceEn: Global heating is benefiting some species but others are too isolated to find suitable new habitat , and gardening habits—paving over gardens and using pesticides—aren't helping either.
habitat.translationZh: 全球变暖对某些物种有利，但另一些物种因过于孤立而无法找到合适的新栖息地，而园艺习惯——将花园铺上硬路面和使用杀虫剂——也无济于事。

habitat.sentenceEn: They move between a variety of habitats , including forests, grasslands, woodlands, wetlands and agricultural land.
habitat.translationZh: 它们在多种栖息地之间迁移，包括森林、草原、林地、湿地和农田。
habitat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

habitat.sentenceEn: The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
habitat.translationZh: 人造草坪行业还声称，铺设人造草坪的人平均会花费500英镑为自家花园购买树木或灌木，这为昆虫提供了栖息地。
habitat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

habitat.sentenceEn: Zoos are at the forefront of conservation and constantly evolving to improve how they care for animals and protect each species in its natural habitat .
habitat.translationZh: 动物园处于动物保护的前沿，并且在不断发展进步，以改善其动物照料方式，并保护每个物种在其自然栖息地的生存。
habitat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

habitat.sentenceEn: The earliest habitats of donkeys are hardly traceable.
habitat.translationZh: 驴的最早栖息地已几乎无迹可寻。

homeless.sentenceEn: The gardens of the homeless , which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environment where it either didn't exist or was not discernible as such.
homeless.translationZh: 无家可归者所打造的花园——实际上就是"无家之园"——为城市环境注入了其原本缺乏或难以辨识的形态。
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

homeless.sentenceEn: There is no doubt that gardens evidence an irrepressible urge to create, express, fashion, and beautify and that self-expression is a basic human urge; yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless , it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression.
homeless.translationZh: 毫无疑问，花园证明了人类内心深处一种难以抑制的冲动——创造、表达、塑造与美化的冲动，而自我表达无疑是人类的基本欲望之一。然而，当我们观看那些无家可归者所创造的花园照片时，我们会突然意识到，尽管这些花园风格各异，但它们所体现的不仅仅是装饰和创造性表达的欲望，还蕴含着其他各种基本的人类渴望。
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

homeless.sentenceEn: In most of the homeless gardens of New York City the actual cultivation of plants is unfeasible, yet even so the compositions often seem to represent attempts to call forth the spirit of plant and animal life, if only symbolically, through a clumplike arrangement of materials, an introduction of colors, small pools of water, and a frequent presence of petals or leaves as well as of stuffed animals.
homeless.translationZh: 在纽约市大多数流浪者的花园中，实际培育植物是不现实的，但即便如此，这些花园的布局设计似乎常常试图唤醒动植物生命的精神——哪怕只是象征性地——通过材料的团块状排列、色彩的引入、小水池，以及频繁出现的花瓣、树叶和填充动物玩具。
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

homeless.sentenceEn: Although the figure may vary, analysts do agree on another matter: that the number of the homeless is increasing.
homeless.translationZh: 尽管具体数字可能有所不同，但分析人士在另一个问题上达成了共识：无家可归者的数量正在增加。
homeless.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

homeless.sentenceEn: To help homeless people toward independence, the federal government must support job training programs, raise the minimum wage, and fund more low-cost housing.
homeless.translationZh: 为了帮助无家可归者实现独立生活，联邦政府必须支持职业培训项目、提高最低工资标准，并资助建设更多低成本住房。
homeless.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

homeless.sentenceEn: Not everyone agrees on the number of Americans who are homeless .
homeless.translationZh: 并非所有人都认同美国无家可归者的具体人数。
homeless.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

harmful.sentenceEn: This abrupt shift to an "intensive mothering narrative", which suggests that mothers should manage childcare alone, was likely to have been harmful .
harmful.translationZh: 这种突然转向“密集型母亲叙事”的转变——即暗示母亲应独自承担育儿责任——很可能具有危害性。
harmful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

harmful.sentenceEn: The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions.
harmful.translationZh: 这项“追回”规则的主要目的是让银行家对有害的冒险行为负责，并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。
harmful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

harmful.sentenceEn: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
harmful.translationZh: 弗吉尼亚大学的心理学研究员阿姆里莎·瓦伊什表示：“学术界正在重新兴起对愧疚感的研究，或者说重新思考愧疚感是什么以及它能起到什么作用。”她补充道，这种重新审视是人们更广泛认识的一部分——即情绪并非二元对立的，在一种情境中有利的情绪在另一种情境中可能有害。
harmful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

harmful.sentenceEn: Fear is both useful and harmful .
harmful.translationZh: 恐惧既有益处，也有害处。
harmful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

harmful.sentenceEn: For H&M to offer a $5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.
harmful.translationZh: 为了能在全球2300多家门店推出这款5.95美元的针织迷你裙，H&M必须依赖海外廉价劳动力，订购量之大足以耗尽自然资源，并且大量使用有害化学物质。
harmful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

harmful.sentenceEn: Although it ruled that there is no constitutional right to physician-assisted suicide, the Court in effect supported the medical principle of "double effect", a centuries-old moral principle holding that an action having two effects—a good one that is intended and a harmful one that is foreseen—is permissible if the actor intends only the good effect.
harmful.translationZh: 尽管最高法院裁定宪法并未赋予医生协助自杀的权利，但实际上支持了"双重效果"这一医疗原则——这是一项有着数百年历史的道德准则，认为如果一个行为可能产生两种结果（一种是期望达到的良好效果，另一种是可预见的不良效果），只要行为实施者仅意图实现良好效果，该行为就是可允许的。
harmful.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
harmful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

hire.sentenceEn: Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates.
hire.translationZh: 雇主们早就意识到招聘中学毕业生的优势，这些毕业生往往证明自己比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚。
hire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

hire.sentenceEn: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
hire.translationZh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
hire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

hire.sentenceEn: And employers are planning on hiring about 17 percent more new graduates for jobs in the U.S. this year than last, according to a survey conducted by the National Association of Colleges and Employers.
hire.translationZh: 美国大学与雇主协会开展的一项调查显示，今年美国雇主计划招聘的应届毕业生人数将比去年增加约17%。
hire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

hire.sentenceEn: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire : Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.
hire.translationZh: 运输安全管理局可以采取一项措施，既不需要改造机场，也不必急于招聘人员，那就是：让更多人加入预检计划。
hire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

hire.sentenceEn: Hire a personal stylist, or use the free styling service of a store like J.Crew.
hire.translationZh: 可以聘请私人造型师，或使用像J.Crew这样的商店提供的免费造型服务。
hire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

hire.sentenceEn: Employers need to hire new staff.

humor.sentenceEn: You may have a circle of friends who provide constant good humor , help and companionship.
humor.translationZh: 你可能有一群朋友，他们总是给你带来欢声笑语、无私帮助和真挚陪伴。
humor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

humor.sentenceEn: Look at your talk and pick out a few words or sentences which you can turn about and inject with humor .
humor.translationZh: 审视一下自己的演讲稿，挑选一些词句进行巧妙转换，注入幽默元素。
humor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
humor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

humor.sentenceEn: Your humor must be relevant to the audience and should help to show them that you are one of them or that you understand their situation and are in sympathy with their point of view.
humor.translationZh: 你的幽默必须与听众相关，并且应该有助于向他们表明你是他们中的一员，或者你理解他们的处境并认同他们的观点。
humor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
humor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

humor.sentenceEn: If you intend using humor in your talk to make people smile, you must know how to identify shared experiences and problems.
humor.translationZh: 如果你想在谈话中运用幽默逗人发笑，就必须知道如何识别听众共有的经历和问题。
humor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
humor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

humor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
humor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

humor.sentenceEn: With other audiences you mustn't attempt to cut in with humor as they will resent an outsider making disparaging remarks about their canteen or their chairman.
humor.translationZh: 而对于其他听众，你千万不要试图贸然插入幽默，因为他们会反感一个外人对他们的食堂或主席发表贬低性评论。
humor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
humor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

host.sentenceEn: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
host.translationZh: 但流媒体时代却意外地成就了一批赢家：盗版者利用软件在几秒钟内从合法在线视频平台上窃取电影或电视节目，然后将这些内容放在自己的非法网站上。这些盗版网站每年通过广告和订阅能赚取约20亿美元。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

host.sentenceEn: The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.
host.translationZh: 该法案要求每位民宿房东在州政府登记注册，强制他们购买保险，并在新增的州税基础上为地方税的征收创造了可能性。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

host.sentenceEn: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
host.translationZh: 要理解当时戏剧活动的繁荣程度，我们还必须记住：大量剧本已然散佚，而任何一位知名剧作家的作品恐怕都未能完整留存。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

host.sentenceEn: Simply arranging a meeting, making a phone call, or hosting an event is not an "official act".
host.translationZh: 仅仅安排会面、打个电话或举办活动并不构成"公务行为"。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

host.sentenceEn: Besides helping you feel close and connected to people you care about, it turns out that hugs can bring a host of health benefits to your body and mind.
host.translationZh: 除了能让你与在乎的人感到亲密无间、心有灵犀之外，事实证明拥抱还能为你的身心带来诸多健康益处。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

host.sentenceEn: Newton's laws of motion and Darwinian evolution each bind a host of different phenomena into a single explicatory framework.
host.translationZh: 牛顿运动定律和达尔文进化论均将众多不同现象纳入统一的解释框架之中。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

healthcare.sentenceEn: As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce—which is already near breaking point—will only become more acute.
healthcare.translationZh: 随着医疗保健需求的持续增长，本已濒临极限的劳动力所面临的压力只会愈发严峻。
healthcare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

healthcare.sentenceEn: It is estimated, for example, that healthcare accounts for only about 20% of health outcomes.
healthcare.translationZh: 例如，据估计医疗保健对健康结果的贡献率仅约为20%。
healthcare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

healthcare.sentenceEn: With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who cannot opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing out investment in other public services.
healthcare.translationZh: 等待名单上的人数已超过680万，对于那些无法选择私人医疗服务的人来说，医疗资源变得越来越难以获取；同时，医疗服务的提供成本不断攀升，正逐渐挤占其他公共服务的投资空间。
healthcare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

healthcare.sentenceEn: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.
healthcare.translationZh: 将这项技术应用于医疗保健领域，其潜力巨大，但同时也可能导致科技巨头的权力进一步集中。
healthcare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

healthcare.sentenceEn: Both the absolute cost of healthcare and the share of it borne by families have risen – and newly fashionable health-savings plans are spreading from legislative halls to Wal-Mart workers, with much higher deductibles and a large new dose of investment risk for families' future healthcare .
healthcare.translationZh: 医疗保健的绝对成本和家庭承担的份额都有所上升——而新流行的健康储蓄计划正从立法机构蔓延到沃尔玛员工，这些计划的免赔额要高得多，并给家庭未来的医疗保健带来了大量新的投资风险。
healthcare.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
healthcare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

household.sentenceEn: What the study doesn't measure is whether people are still doing work when they're at home, whether it is household work or work brought home from the office.
household.translationZh: 该研究并未衡量人们在家时是否仍在工作——无论是家务劳动还是从办公室带回的工作。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

household.sentenceEn: Rare is the household in which the division of labor is so clinically and methodically laid out.
household.translationZh: 很少有家庭能如此客观、有条理地划分家务劳动。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

household.sentenceEn: And for women who work outside the home, they often are playing catch-up with household tasks.
household.translationZh: 而对于外出工作的女性而言，她们往往还要忙着补上家务劳动。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

household.sentenceEn: A big survey of Indian households in 2004 found that nearly 40% of emigrants had more than a high-school education, compared with around 3.3% of all Indians over the age 25.
household.translationZh: 2004年一项针对印度家庭的大型调查发现，近40%的移民拥有高中以上学历，而在所有25岁以上的印度人中，这一比例约为3.3%。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

household.sentenceEn: More families consist of one-parent households or two working parents; consequently, children are likely to have less supervision at home than was common in the traditional family structure.
household.translationZh: 如今，越来越多的家庭成为单亲家庭或双职工家庭；因此，与传统家庭结构相比，孩子们在家中受到的监督可能会更少。
household.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

household.sentenceEn: With economic growth has come centralization; fully 76 percent of Japan's 119 million citizens live in cities where community and the extended family have been abandoned in favor of isolated, two-generation households .
household.translationZh: 随着经济的发展，日本出现了集中化趋势；其1.19亿人口中，多达76%居住在城市。在这些城市里，社区和大家庭的观念已被摒弃，取而代之的是独居式的两代人小家庭。
household.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句
